annotations.title: Fund balance with a shared payment token

description: fundBalanceWithSharedPaymentToken: Stage adding funds to the balance by charging a Stripe Shared Payment Token the customer granted to OSIR. Use when a purchase (registerDomain, renewDomain, transferDomain, orderVps) failed for insufficient funds: that error tells you the networkId to mint against and both amounts. Mint the token for the GROSS and pass the NET as creditCents. Tokens are single-use. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; tell the user what the card will be charged, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. If this fails in any way you cannot fix by minting a fresh token, fall back to createPaymentSession and give the user the checkout URL.

creditCents.description: NET amount to land in the balance, in minor units (cents). Use fundNetCents from the insufficient-funds error. The card is charged this plus the processing fee.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, default USD. Must match the balance currency.

description.description: What the funds are for, e.g. 'Funding registration of example.com'. Lands on the customer's transaction record.

maxChargeCents.description: The usage_limits max_amount the token was minted with, i.e. fundGrossCents. Supplying it lets OSIR reject an impossible charge without calling Stripe.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

sharedPaymentToken.description: The Stripe Shared Payment Token, 'spt_...'. Minted for the GROSS amount against the networkId from the insufficient-funds error. Single-use.

name: fundBalanceWithSharedPaymentToken
